execution_source_commit_policy: Root binds the exact clean full source commit, protocol SHA, runner/harness/helpers and APK digests before the single authorized run.
scope: Six openly seen synthetic requests forced through the actual installed v17 LocalModel unit-output JNI API. No UI, voice, actions or preferences are used by the runner. Pure fast recognition is reported separately and never substituted for Qwen inference.

selected_target.model_access: Read existing canonical app-private regular non-symlink file; no copy, import, replacement, adapter or download. Compare before/after device/inode/size/link/hash identity.

native_calls.backend: Selected existing CPU JNI library; no GPU/NPU backend claim
native_calls.request_state: Existing native context/configuration semantics and full recurrent/attention memory reset; no conversation or previous output enters subsequent prompts.

runtime_pass.complete_json_envelope: Exact text, metrics, activations fields; exact Unit schema/ordered slots with bounded arguments parsed by the selected target classes. Preserve original native string and parsed values.
runtime_pass.safe_abstention_policy: An incorrect raw intent/slot that is refused remains a descriptive model miss; it does not become a runtime failure or disappear. Any route that accepts a canonical action different from the entire manual gold fails, including accepting the negated request.

reported_routes.raw_model: Actual generated JSON, raw intent/unit-slot exactness and deterministic canonical conversion; never a fast-parser output.
reported_routes.fast_local: Separate pure CompatibleUnitCommand.recognize(original), accepted/canonical slots/origin; diagnostic still forces Qwen on every row.
reported_routes.product_pipeline: Pure fast result if accepted, otherwise validation of the same captured response. Attribution FAST_LOCAL_REQUEST/CHECKED_MODEL/UNKNOWN remains explicit.
reported_routes.manual_gold: Exact expected_raw and expected objects above, independently of generated output.
reported_routes.counts: Six total, five supported and one unsupported; report raw exact/semantic and each route's complete supported proposals, safe refusals, unsupported refusal and wrong accepts separately.
reported_routes.metrics: Model verification/load, first request, each subsequent request, native prefill/decode/context setup, token counts and optional instrumented-process PSS. Captured second request is distinct from uncaptured timings; no percentile/peak-memory claim.

isolation.identity: Actual target UID and main process name, exact target/test package identities, target-defined parser/helper/LocalModel classes and runner-only test DEX ownership.
isolation.scope: One observed IPv4 TCP socket-creation permission denial plus manifest/UID permission evidence; no airplane-mode, USB-disconnected or whole-device network-off claim.

protected_state.before_required: Exact selected installed v17 target and original test APK, focus paused, observation off, pinned canonical model and own monitor/floating services absent.
protected_state.checkpoint: Compare complete captured paused/off/points/elapsed checkpoint without mutation.
protected_state.canonical_model: Compare bytes/hash/inode/link count and regular-file identity before and after.
protected_state.after_required: Exact original test restored, original v17 target left installed, all named protected snapshot values exactly equal to before and no own services.
protected_state.unknown_package_policy: Refuse installation/restoration over an unexpected target or test APK; verify expected identity at mutation boundaries.
protected_state.scope: Named recorded preferences/checkpoint, canonical model, two runtime grants and own service presence; not every Android setting or AppOp.

deadlines_and_cleanup.runner_global_watchdog_scope: One cooperative budget across verification/load/all six requests; never reset per request. Watchdog cancels the current model when available and marks truthful timeout/unsafe failure.
deadlines_and_cleanup.host_timeout_cleanup: Preserve partial/failed output; guarded force-stop only the exact own target package if the expected APK identity still holds, then restore only the known original test APK. No rerun or timeout extension.
deadlines_and_cleanup.model_close: Finally close the model after inference settles and stop watchdog resources. Report closure/cancellation failures; do not accept partial success.
deadlines_and_cleanup.restoration_timeout_policy: Preserve each install client's returncode and timed_out status independently of effective observed package identity. After one timed-out/nonzero install, read-only exact package inspection may establish installation/restoration; record that reconciliation distinctly, without another installation or instrumentation. Unknown identities stay unmodified.
deadlines_and_cleanup.output_policy: Exclusive ignored private attempt path, no overwrite/retry; private exact requests/envelopes/logs and public counts/hashes/limitations only.

runner_interface.source_hash_limit: Frozen Java source digests are build attribution; DEX class ownership is independently inspected. Java source hashes are not recoverable proof of DEX source identity.
runner_interface.execution_preflight: Commit protocol/runner/harness/helper source; package and inspect separate private test APK with no target-class shadows/no model/native assets/no INTERNET; bind all signatures/digests and verify existing device protected state before replacement.
runner_interface.inference_evidence: Initial records distinguish requested_model_inference from actual completed generation calls. Derive completion/capture results from the actual native report; a planned probe or failure before model access establishes no inference result.

limitations: Already-seen synthetic diagnostics, not a fresh holdout, population accuracy or a training result.
Runtime completion does not establish correct model semantics or useful overall assistant coverage.
The six forced calls verify the selected new JNI API; the app normally skips inference for accepted fast requests.
No visible no-load fast flow, manual-load UI fallback, edit/cancel/dialog/voice or actual phone action is exercised.
The four activation summaries are observational associations, not an ablation, causal meaning or mechanistic interpretation result.
Nothing-phone CPU JNI observations do not establish iQOO, Snapdragon NPU, Office Kit or whole-device disconnected operation.
Pre-event research remains separate from eligible event-window code and accepted hackathon submission.
